description.zh: 同一张输入图与不同自然语言指令、输出效果成组展示，任务一眼清楚，适合学习低说明成本的图像编辑 Teaser。
description.en: Pairs a source image with instruction-conditioned outcomes; a strong image-editing teaser that requires little explanation.

zh: 需要通过多个可感知的视觉变化讲清一个 AIGC 方法的作用时。
en: Showing the purpose of an AIGC editing method through several visually legible transformations.

zh: 保持输入身份可对齐；重复网格提供稳定比较基准，短指令直接担当图注；复杂编辑故事以视觉变化而不是模块说明展开。
en: Repeated source identity anchors comparisons; brief instructions double as captions; visual changes carry the claim without pipeline clutter.

zh: 图中绘画和人像有额外内容权利；外链仅用于学习排版，不授予改编或再分发许可。
en: Visual sources may contain separate artwork rights; linking is not permission to adapt or redistribute the images.
